steps.text: Twenty-three hours into the operation...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The route ahead has been cleared.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: I'll continue scouting the Sarkaz army's movements. Haven't found any trace of them yet.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Thank you, Misery. Continue to set up those sentry posts.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Morgan, found any surviving Victorian soldiers where you're at?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I'm afraid not.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Nothing but Originium crystals here.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: We haven't run into any Victorian troops, corpses, or wrecks since we entered the Westbound Forest.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Dammit! We can tell there's been a bloody huge battle, so where've all the people gone?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: The terrain here keeps changing. Maybe the ground... ate them all up.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We cannot underestimate the tenacity of the people. It is only because there are those who refuse to give up that the Exemplars even exist.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It's why we're here in the first place.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Shearer, keep the medics ready to receive any army remnants and civilians.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: We've got extra supplies, so no need to worry on that front.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: The bad news is that with so many Infected among our troops now, it's almost impossible to distinguish between infected and uninfected soldiers.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'd like your professional opinion on that matter. Would registering the Infected help our men or not?

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: Funny you should ask. 'Registering the Infected'... That might have been the first thing they taught me at the military academy.

steps.name: Shearer
steps.text: But where we stand now, I'd say there's no real sense to it.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I see. Then let's stop registering them.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Just try your best to provide everyone, infected or not, with Rhodes Island's recommended protective measures.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The rest... is not up to us anymore, at least not for now.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Let's all focus on surviving this war first. Then we can worry about the wars to come.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Oh, my drone's back.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: How awful, the entire propulsion system has been clotted up by crystal dust.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Based on monitored data, environmental Originium concentration is still fluctuating wildly.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Send me that data you just got, Rockrock. We've got a new iteration of our Originium activation trend model, and I want to see if our calculations fit real-world data.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Ugh, looks like there's not enough data to do that. The trend of this curve... Let's wait for Viktor's team to finish off that diffractometer analysis report, then we should be able to calculate the safe areas in real-time.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: This place freaks me out. It's like one minute it's deadly quiet, the next there's some terrifying Originium mountain pushing its way up out of the dirt. The safe areas keep changing.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Although we've managed to reestablish short-range comms after working our asses off, if you go even a step out of range, all that interference'll just get in the way again.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Good thing I planned ahead and asked Raidian for her Arts Unit before we left for Londinium. After a little copy and paste, I made a knockoff version. It's not as good as the real deal, but it should help.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Once we've got these portable communications towers up, we'll be able to transmit the locations of the safe areas to anyone on the battlefield who needs them.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: This information will save many lives.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Well, yeah. That's what Rhodes Island does.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Horn, status update.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We've successfully arrived at Gibsonham. It's the last supply point before we reach the front at Silverrock Bluffs.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The reconnaissance team's already made their initial scouting report. Looks like there are traces of the ducal armies here. Must have passed through on the way to the front a few days ago.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I think we can confirm at this point that the route Trilby Asher provided is safe.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Is there anyone in town?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The streets are empty, but I can sense the flicker of shadows and the smell of food.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We decided against contact to avoid unneeded misunderstandings.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Understood. We'll rendezvous with you as soon as we can.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It's getting dark.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Seems like everything's going smoothly. Best we let our fighters get some rest and some hot soup in them.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Remember to save some for my team! They'll be taking a while longer to get back after their work is done. Rockrock and I still have to head over to Feist...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I'm not sure if we'll be able to double our communication range by nightfall, but we'll do our best to finish ASAP.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No need to worry, we'll save the best for your people.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...It's all just the same canned provisions though, right?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Would you like some engine oil for dressing then?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oi!

steps.name: Siege & Rockrock
steps.text: Hahahahaha!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: All units, continue onwards until you reach Gibsonham.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I hope things can be as peaceful tonight as things are now.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: All the houses seem to be empty. Have the residents gone into hiding?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Gibsonham's not far from the dukes' defense line, so I doubt the Sarkaz ever fully captured it, not to mention that the ducal armies just passed through a few days ago.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Horn's caution is warranted, though. There might be some scattered ducal troops who want to reconvene with the main army and decided to camp out here first.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Although Trilby Asher's helping us out with his advice, Victoria's never exactly been a model for unity.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Not to mention the... complicated nature of the Exemplars. I dare say there are a few old-fashioned military nobles who would rather not tolerate our very existence.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I see, then let's show them the full scale of our forces. It'll deter those with ulterior motives and alert anyone who needs our help of our arrival.
The rumbling of traveling tanks reverberates through the quiet night, the low roar of the engines forceful yet steady.
The soldiers cautiously advance, observing their surroundings, but still, all they see are pitch-black windows and doorways.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: It doesn't look like they want to make first contact.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: That's fine, as long as it means we can get along—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Wait, I hear something. From the building to the front and left.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: That's the sound of artillery shell casings falling on the ground!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: An ambush?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: On your guard, everyone. I'll lead a team to scout ahead.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: First Squad, Second Squad, follow my lead!
There are no signs of life in the abandoned factory.
Contrary to expectation, there is no sound of an explosion following the fallen casings.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Are you sure that was falling casings, Horn?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Absolutely sure. That's a special model only allocated to elite Victorian troops.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No traces of anyone living here—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Don't move, Siege.
Siege carefully puts her foot down back to where it was.
Horn points at a thin tripwire, barely visible against the ground.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Nicely concealed, what with the surrounding piping obstructing the view. Real tricky to spot.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: A booby trap?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: No... It's not linked to any explosives, just a simple alarm system. Based on how they've installed it, I'd say they're military.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Should we try to initiate contact?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Yes. Everyone, get behind us, and prepare to engage.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Hello, we don't mean any harm!

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Our unit's called the—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: A secret passage!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Get ready to enter! Stay behind my shield!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Halt!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We're not...

steps.name: Victorian Soldier?
steps.text: H-Help!

steps.name: Injured Soldier
steps.text: I knocked over some spent ammunition while on watch. How could they have heard from so far away?! They avoided your alarm, too!

steps.name: Injured Soldier
steps.text: These troops, I don't think they're any ordinary—

steps.name: Injured Soldier
steps.text: She... She can block your piledriver spear?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Captain? And Siege too?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It really is you, Fiona.
The lady with long, red hair suddenly throws herself into the arms of her captain.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: So ye were alive all along...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Wonderful... how wonderful.
Horn gently releases Bagpipe from her embrace, then claps a hand on her shoulder.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Good to see you in one piece, and in rather good shape, too.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I-I'll make my report now, Captain! I've done it, I've managed tae extract the intelligence on the Spectre Force, and I ken what they're plannin' now!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I survived! I got my memories, I got the truth, and I stayed alive!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Yer orders... I never forgot a word of 'em.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Good to hear. I knew you could do it. I always knew.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Welcome back, Bagpipe.

steps.name: Injured Soldier
steps.text: Wait, she's...? You're not—

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Everyone, we mean you no harm. It's alright to come out.
One by one, silhouettes emerge from the shadows.
The elderly, children, the sick and the wounded, civilians.
Hundreds of pairs of eyes stare at Siege and her men in fear and curiosity, taking their measure.

steps.name: Injured Soldier
steps.text: You're not with the ducal armies?

steps.name: Injured Soldier
steps.text: M-Most of you aren't dressed like Victorian soldiers. In fact, you mostly look like workers to me?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: That's right. We're not under any of the dukes.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We're called the Exemplars.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Shearer's counting up the civilians who were hiding in the factory and giving them a check-up. All he can say at the moment is that it's looking better than we expected.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Aside from those infected soldiers under the Duke of Fife who came along with you, and a small team of military engineers under the Duke of Normandy, everyone else is just local civilians who couldn't escape.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The ducal alliance armies came through here a few days ago, but they rather give up a chance at being rescued than seek help from the Grand Dukes.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: It's understandable why the soldiers would avoid them. They're either worried about the status of their infection, or worried about a court-martial. But as for the civilians...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Perhaps this was the year the people living around Londinium got to reassess their country and those decorated higher-ups.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Bagpipe, how did you manage to get their trust—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: ...Are you listening, Bagpipe?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Huh? Oh, er, aye, Captain!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You need to pay attention during tactical meetings. The map's on the wall, not my face.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Sorry, Captain!
Horn lets out a small sigh.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: *sigh* I really shouldn't be asking. You are Fiona, after all.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Hehe.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I'm just... a wee bit glad.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: The Exemplars, the Tempest Platoon's predecessors. I guess the rumors were true.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I'm actually amazed that you still remember what you learned in military history class.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Well of course! When I was still at trainin' camp, Triangle made sure I committed this fact to memory!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Out by the trainin' field, the sycamores were full o' leaves, blockin' the sun juuust right. Then there were the rocks at the top of the cliff, hard as, well, rocks. Hand'll sting if ye tried to climb them.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I remember when Cello and Oboe had a wager on who could complete the rock climbing training course the fastest. The loser had to do a hundred one-handed push-ups.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oboe was a right fool! Who would've taken that bet wi Cello?!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Maybe you should have reminded him back then. You were even sitting on his back the whole time he was doing those push-ups.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Hehe. I was just helpin' him with his training. And I'd say it turned out alright in the end, aye? He was just a hair behind Cello the next time!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The Exemplars... When the Tempest Platoon was first established, nothing was left of this legendary unit from the War of the Four Nations, not even its unassigned unit ID.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: But now, it has returned once more to the battlefield.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We're all members of the Exemplars now, Bagpipe.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: As long as our team is still here, we will never stop fighting the good fight.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Isn't there a strategy meeting inside? Why're you standing out here in the cold?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Just wanted to clear my head for a few minutes.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Did you think I was someone else?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Baird, or...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No, not really.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: I believe you. If someone suddenly popped out of the fog tonight, I wouldn't have any expectations either.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Not everyone is as lucky as Horn, reuniting with the person they most want to see.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: 'Luck' eh? That's a luxury around here.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: That's enough blues for tonight. We should head inside.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Victorian soldiers? Are they the remnants who stayed behind?

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: No, they can't be. I never noticed them until they got this close.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: They're the elite of the elites.

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Caster's men?
Ah! It's positively frigid out here! My hands are frozen stiff.
The days truly are getting colder as they go by.
Why, I've only taken a little jaunt, and my full plaid's already half soaked through.

steps.name: Duke of Gododdin
steps.text: My young friends, won't you invite me inside to warm my hands for a spell?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Since you've come all this way in person, I suppose we should show you some courtesy.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Delphine—

steps.name: Delphine
steps.text: Yes, Vina?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Let's show the duke the way.
